title: GateDecisionRequest
description: Body of POST /approvals/:id/decision on the phone listener: a signed approval, or a reject. intentId must equal the id in the path. An edit is POST /approvals/:id/edit (GateEditRequest), whose new intent is then approved here.

oneOf.title: GateApproveRequest
oneOf.description: Approve with a WebAuthn assertion over the challenge built from payloadHash, intentId and the nonce from the latest prepare (see vectors/approval-challenge-vectors.json).

nonce.description: The nonce the assertion was signed over, as returned by prepare.

oneOf.title: GateRejectRequest
oneOf.description: Reject a pending intent, with an optional reason code.
